bullets.text: AI Actress Sparks Hollywood Backlash - **Tilly Norwood**, an AI-generated actress, faces strong opposition from industry professionals.
UK Demands Apple Backdoor - The UK government is pushing **Apple** for backdoor access to iCloud user data again.
California Leads AI Safety - California's new **AI** safety law mandates transparency from major labs like **OpenAI**.
Instagram Denies Spying Claims - **Meta** insists it does not use microphones to listen to users for ad targeting.
Waymo Extends NYC Testing - **Waymo** can continue testing its robotaxis in New York City until the end of 2025.
OpenAI's Sora App Launches - **OpenAI** introduces Sora, a social media app featuring AI-generated content and deepfakes.
Philips Launches New Roku TV - **Philips** unveils Roku TVs with its signature Ambilight feature for enhanced viewing.
Einride Raises $100M for Trucks - **Einride** secures $100 million to expand its electric and autonomous freight technology.
Instagram Tests Reels Home Tab - **Meta** is exploring making Reels the main tab on Instagram to boost engagement.
AI in Basketball Stats - **Amazon** introduces advanced AI analytics for NBA fans, enhancing game insights.
